title: Agent Identity broker metadata (agent-broker.json)
description: Contract I: the public document served at GET /.well-known/agent-broker.json. All six fields are REQUIRED and unknown fields are not permitted. `issuer` MUST equal the origin of the document itself and the `iss` of every attestation the broker signs; a differing issuer invalidates the document. `jwks_uri` MUST be same-origin with `issuer` (a cross-field rule enforced by Zod and the validator, not expressible here). Cross-origin `attestation_status_uri`/`abuse_endpoint` are allowed but must pass the same SSRF rules; same-origin is RECOMMENDED. Normative definition: agent-identity-v1.md §16.

issuer.description: Canonical origin of this document; MUST equal the `iss` of every attestation the broker signs.

jwks_uri.description: Absolute HTTPS URL of the broker JWKS. MUST be on the same origin as `issuer`.

attestation_status_uri.description: Absolute HTTPS URL of the signed attestation status endpoint (spec §5.5 / §16).

abuse_endpoint.description: Absolute HTTPS URL accepting Contract D.2 authenticated abuse reports.

protocol_versions.description: Non-empty, unique list of protocol versions; MUST contain `agent-identity-v1`.

contact.description: Email address or absolute HTTPS URL a human can use for security/abuse contact.
